title: API Security: BOLA, BFLA and mass assignment
description: API-exclusive attacks per OWASP: reading other users' objects, running admin functions and promoting yourself with one extra JSON field.

api-security-t01-q01.prompt: Which number of the OWASP API Top 10 does BOLA (Broken Object Level Authorization) hold?

api-security-t01-q02.prompt: You are alice (id=2). Retrieve order 1002, which belongs to another user. Submit the flag.

api-security-t01-q03.prompt: What field should the server compare in /api/orders/{id} to close the hole?

2.title: BFLA, mass assignment and unlimited consumption

api-security-t02-q01.prompt: Delete bob's account (id=3) while being alice. Submit the BFLA achievement flag.

api-security-t02-q02.prompt: Create an account with role admin by abusing the API copying any JSON field. Submit the flag.

api-security-t02-q03.prompt: The /api/export endpoint dumps the whole database with no rate limit or pagination. Submit the flag it gives away.
